loadTypes.title: Load types
loadTypes.description: What a light or motor is electrically (LED, halogen, motor). Limits per channel can differ by load type. Seeded; rarely changed.
loadTypes.activeHint: Inactive load types cannot be chosen for new needs.
loadTypes.powerFactorHint: Converts the power of needs (W) into current (A) for limits in A: I = P / (V · power factor). LED about 0.9, motors about 0.7, resistive loads 1.

outputKinds.title: Channel kinds
outputKinds.description: The kinds of channel a device has (dimmer, relay, blind, input). Each kind lists the functions it can serve. Seeded; rarely changed.
outputKinds.activeHint: Inactive channel kinds cannot be chosen for new fields.
outputKinds.functionTypesHint: The functions a channel of this kind can drive.
outputKinds.alternativeHint: Channels of another kind that together can act as one of this kind, e.g. 2 relay outputs as 1 blind output (fixed pairs 1+2, 3+4, …). A product uses them only where it allows it (meaning "May act as another channel kind").
outputKinds.alternativeCountHint: How many of those channels make one of this kind (1–16).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The spreadsheet columns SnapFlow understands. A field with a meaning feeds the checks; without one it is just information.
fields.keyHint: Lower snake case, e.g. dimmer_outputs. Import columns with this name are matched.
fields.label: Label
fields.unitHint: Shown with the value, e.g. W, mA, TE.
fields.meaningTypes: This meaning needs the value type: {{types}}.
fields.productTypesHint: The meaning applies only to products of these systems; none ticked = all.
fields.lockedHint: Fixed while categories link this field.
fields.loadTypeOptionalHint: Leave at "Any load type" for a limit that applies to every load.
fields.optionsFixed: This meaning needs exactly these choices; their labels can change.

meaning.alternative_allowed: May act as another channel kind

none.description: Shown on the product and exported, never checked

channels_supplied.description: How many channels of one kind the device has

channel_limit_w.description: The most load one channel may switch, for one load type; checked against the needs it serves

channel_limit_a.description: The most current one channel may switch; the needs' W are converted with the voltage

channel_min_load_w.description: The least load one channel needs to work properly

channel_voltage.description: The voltage the channels switch when it differs from the system's

module_total_a.description: The most current the whole device may switch over all its channels

module_total_w.description: The most load the whole device may switch over all its channels

bus_current_used_ma.description: mA taken from the bus line; used for the line's power supply check

bus_current_supplied_ma.description: mA a power supply feeds into the bus line; the line's devices may not draw more

bus_devices_max.description: How many devices one bus line may hold

rail_width_te.description: In TE (17.5 mm); used for the board's capacity

enclosure_rows.description: How many DIN rails an enclosure has; marks the product as an enclosure

enclosure_te_per_row.description: How many TE fit on one rail of the enclosure

wireless_places_supplied.description: How many wireless devices a gateway or coordinator can take

wireless_place_used.description: How many places of the gateway a wireless device takes (yes = 1)

zigbee_router.description: The device forwards Zigbee messages and extends the mesh

motor_type.description: Whether the blind channels drive AC or DC motors; matched against the motor of a blind

alternative_allowed.description: The device's channels may act as another kind, e.g. 2 relays as 1 blind channel
